data: Does the test error rate for BERT_SDA (K = T - 1) decrease as the self-distillation weight lambda increases from 0.1 to 1.0?
No, the test error rate for BERT_SDA (K = T - 1) does not decrease as the self-distillation weight lambda increases from 0.1 to 1.0.
